content:
In the quiet space between two breaths,  
morning pours its pale gold light,  
and every ordinary object—  
cup, key, curtain—  
learns to shine.

A sparrow stitches air with song,  
the street sweeps yesterday away,  
and somewhere in your chest a door  
you didn’t know was closed  
gives gently.

Carry this:  
not every storm is thunder—  
some arrive as silence  
and leave behind  
a clearer sky.
